title: Northgate Marketplace Guarantee Decision and Reimbursement Schedule
content:
**Decision and reimbursement schedule.** Once a Northgate Marketplace Guarantee claim is filed under Northgate Marketplace Orders and the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee, the seller's time to resolve it, Northgate's decision time, the return requirement for a not-as-described claim and the per-order maximum follow the seller program of the order. The six seller programs of Northgate Marketplace Orders and the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee are Northgate Marketplace Seller-Fulfilled, Northgate Marketplace Pro Seller, Northgate Marketplace Fulfilled by Northgate, Northgate Marketplace Freight Seller, Northgate Marketplace Certified Renewed and Northgate Marketplace International Seller; the columns below carry their names without the Northgate Marketplace prefix.

| Term | Seller-Fulfilled | Pro Seller | Fulfilled by Northgate | Freight Seller | Certified Renewed | International Seller |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Business days the seller is given to answer a filed claim before Northgate decides | 3 | 3 | 0 | 3 | 3 | 3 |
| Business days after the seller's response deadline within which Northgate decides the claim | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 |
| A not-as-described claim is reimbursed only after the item is returned with tracking | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Calendar days after a claim decision requiring a return within which the buyer must ship the item back | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 |
| Most reimbursed under the guarantee for one order, USD | 2500 | 2500 | 2500 | 5000 | 2500 | 2500 |
| Amount reimbursed: price paid for the affected items plus their shipping, less anything the seller already refunded | price paid less seller refunds | price paid less seller refunds | price paid less seller refunds | price paid less seller refunds | price paid less seller refunds | price paid less seller refunds |
| Tender for guarantee reimbursements | original payment | original payment | original payment | original payment | original payment | original payment |

**Points of reading.**

- The guarantee maximum per order is USD 2500 on every program except Freight Seller, where it is USD 5000; it is an amount per order, not per claim.
- A seller response figure of 0 under Fulfilled by Northgate reflects that Northgate is the seller-side party; elsewhere the seller is given 3 business days, and Northgate decides within 4 business days after that deadline.
